name: Flash
description: A high-tempo striker who turns clean answers into steady pressure.
passive: Overclock: while your ultimate is active, each correct adds a Power stack (max 5). Every stack adds a flat damage chip on your next hits; a wrong answer removes two stacks instead of wiping you clean.
ultimateDescription: 10 seconds. Each correct adds Power (up to 5). Each Power stack adds flat bonus damage on your attacks. Wrong answers strip 2 stacks.

name: Shadow
description: A disruptor that shrinks the opponent's decision space.
passive: Neural Jam: on ult, the opponent gets a shorter question timer, periodic input locks, and extra HP pain if they answer wrong while jammed.
ultimateDescription: 10 seconds. Opponent questions run faster, they get brief input locks, and wrong answers during the jam take extra HP damage.

name: Guardian
description: A defensive specialist that turns absorbed pressure into a finishing burst.
passive: Reflect Bastion: while your ultimate is up you take less damage, bank part of what you prevent, and fire it back when Bastion ends (capped burst).
ultimateDescription: 10 seconds. You mitigate incoming hits, store prevented damage, then release it as one shockwave when Bastion ends (damage capped).

name: Blaze
description: A burn specialist that ramps damage over the ultimate window.
passive: Blaze Surge: correct answers add burn stacks while your ultimate is active. Burn ticks chip the opponent; wrong answers shave one stack.
ultimateDescription: 10 seconds. Correct answers add burn stacks; burn ticks every ~0.9s. Wrong answers remove one stack.

name: Architect
premiumTagline: I don't fight your game. I rewrite it.
howItPlays: Perfect Sequence: chain correct answers; every third correct detonates a precision burst. Wrong answers reset the chain. You take slightly less damage while it is active.
description: A precision combo engineer built around clean sequences.
passive: Perfect Sequence builds toward a burst on every third correct answer during your ultimate; wrong answers reset the chain; light damage mitigation while active.
ultimateDescription: 13 seconds (premium). Every third correct in the window deals a big burst; wrong answers reset the combo counter; you take slightly less damage while active.

name: Titan
premiumTagline: I don't lose trades. I win them.
howItPlays: Overpower: heavier hits, heal from damage dealt, tougher against incoming hits, and no self-HP penalty on wrong answers while the ultimate runs.
description: A bruiser that wins trades through heavy damage and sustain.
passive: Overpower: while your ultimate is active, your correct-answer hits deal more damage, you heal from part of the damage dealt, you resist more incoming damage, and wrong answers do not cost self-HP.
ultimateDescription: 13 seconds (premium). Your correct-answer damage is amplified, you heal from damage dealt, you resist incoming hits, and wrong answers do not deal self-damage.
